row_order_definition: Rows follow canonical vocabulary sorted by token_id; embedding row index = token_id - 1.

candidate_representations.name: static_gene_identity_embedding
candidate_representations.notes: Sample-invariant embedding lookup table from the frozen checkpoint.

candidate_representations.name: contextual_gene_token_embeddings
candidate_representations.tensor: hidden states after Transformer layers (e.g., L1/L6/L12)
candidate_representations.notes: Requires a reference cohort and aggregation choice; context-dependent by design.

candidate_representations.name: sample_level_embeddings
candidate_representations.notes: Produces per-sample vectors, not per-gene embeddings.

phase0_recommendation: Use static_gene_identity_embedding for Zhong-style fixed-gene benchmark unless/until a separate contextual protocol is approved.
